[Trigger: Action] Used simultaneously with your [Sword][Spear][Axe][Melee] tag weapon's [Weapon Attack]. Changes the attack to "Range: 2Sq". Once per scene. A forearm guard imbued with magic that twists space. A single strike wielded with this hand can attack enemies across distance.

Curse Pattern Core Material[Core Material](100G)+Arm Guard(120G)+Mana Blazer(120G)+[Magic Catalyst 7](60G)×2+Crafting Cost(200G)
